description: This header file declares platform-specific functions for monitoring filesystem events in the fsmonitor daemon backend. It defines initialization, cleanup, event loop, and shutdown functions related to the filesystem listener thread.

methods.name: fsm_listen__ctor
methods.description: Initializes platform-specific state for the fsmonitor listener thread.

methods.name: fsm_listen__dtor
methods.description: Cleans up platform-specific resources for the fsmonitor listener thread.

methods.name: fsm_listen__loop
methods.description: Contains the main event loop for filesystem event monitoring; runs in its own thread.

methods.name: fsm_listen__stop_async
methods.description: Requests a graceful shutdown of the listener thread asynchronously.
